_about: 30 s office-sourcing Reel (1080x1920), v2: a real person (licensed Adobe Stock footage of one actor) at his desk, standing up, walking his office, while his own voice (Lebanese Arabic, male, first person) tells the story. Hook → problem → solution → CTA (fill the form = your first month free) → last hook (then only 9 dollars a month; the live Play price is $8.99). Lines 1 and 5 are spoken on camera by the AI avatar (Veo, avatar_shots.json); lines 2-4 and 6 are this voice-over. Rendered by marketing/source/reel_v3_compose.py.
dialect: You are a native Lebanese Arabic speaker from Beirut (Achrafieh / Hamra), telling his own story in an Instagram reel as a voice-over, talking to colleagues like a friend would. Speak natural, everyday BEIRUTI LEBANESE, never Syrian or Damascene, never Palestinian or Jordanian, never Egyptian, never Modern Standard Arabic. Lebanese cues: the soft, relaxed Beirut melody (not the Damascene sing-song), final -a / -ā raised to -e the Beirut way (فاضية sounds 'fāḍye', ساعة 'sē3a'), ق as a glottal stop, 'هلّق' as 'halla2', 'كتير' with a short i, words linked smoothly. Sound like a real person talking to a friend: relaxed, warm, conversational rhythm, natural breaths and small pauses, a smile in the voice. Never theatrical, never a TV announcer. English words (ProHost, Premium, app, form, comment, office, DM, psychologists, coaches) are said naturally in English, the way Lebanese professionals say them.

posts.persona: A Lebanese psychologist in his late 30s who rents out his own clinic by the hour on ProHost. Warm, honest, a little proud of the solution he found; talking to fellow therapists and coaches.

lines.style: Honest confession that hooks; a small sigh before 'فاضية'.
lines.text: بدفع أجار عيادتي كامل… وهيّي فاضية نُصّ النهار.
بين جلسة وجلسة، ساعات ضايعة… ومصاري عم تطير.
هلّق عم أجّرها بالساعة على ProHost، لـ psychologists و coaches متلي.

lines.style: Calm and confident: I'm in control.
lines.text: أنا بحدّد الوقت والسعر، والطلبات بتوصلني عَالواتساب.

lines.text: إذا بدّك مكتب، نزّل التطبيق، تفتّش وتحجز كِلّو مجّاني.

lines.text: وبعد الشهر؟ بسّ تسعة دولار بالشهر… أقلّ من أجار ساعة وحدة.
وإذا عندك مكتب بدّك تعرضو، comment أو DM، ليوصلك كِل التفاصيل وتربح شهر مجّاني.
